candidate_freeze.canonicalization: Use exactly the normative nb1-eval-canonical-json-v1 byte_profile for JSON objects and its artifact_kind_mapping for UTF-8 text, binary, and directory/bundle artifacts; no local alternative, reviewer-selected equivalent, or partial summary is permitted.
reproducibility_requirements: A reviewer can recompute every listed digest from the accepted public candidate bundle and declared canonicalization.
The training artifact records public train/development provenance and excludes hidden seed, labels, latent metadata, provider implementation details, and per-sequence correctness.
Any source, dependency, model, parameter, protocol, threshold, or generator change after freeze invalidates the receipt and requires a new review cycle.

hidden_dataset_and_seed.v4_custody_binding: The requested hidden_dataset_provider duty is logically distinct but must be performed by independent_evaluator_only under frozen EVAL-01 v4. A separate provider/evaluator organization is prohibited until a separately accepted v4 revalidation.

required_roles.implementation_owner: owns public source and candidate preparation; cannot self-attest independence, custody, or gate passage
required_roles.hidden_artifact_provider: logical hidden-dataset custody duty performed by independent_evaluator_only under frozen v4; it does not authorize a separate provider organization
required_roles.independent_evaluator: owns fresh network-disabled scoring, baselines, ablations, complete attempt ledger, aggregate report, and signer custody
required_roles.independent_reviewer: owns admissibility review, accepted registries, identity attestations, key acceptance, and gate-review recommendation

separation_rules: Implementation owner, independent evaluator, and independent reviewer identities, organizations, reporting lines, and conflicting financial or operational interests require external attestation. Frozen v4 requires the hidden_dataset_provider duty to be performed by independent_evaluator_only.

No actor may self-certify a required separation or substitute a subagent, branch, worktree, repository role, or identifier prefix for organizational independence. A separate provider/evaluator identity is rejected under frozen v4.
The implementation owner cannot hold the hidden seed or labels, operate scoring, choose omitted attempts, approve its own evidence, or control the accepted public-key or attestation registries.
The evaluator may not modify the frozen candidate, evaluation thresholds, generator contract, or accepted registries after hidden commitment.

public_key_registry_requirements: Each entry contains signer_id, Ed25519 public key, key fingerprint, custody attestation digest, validity interval, revocation status, and reviewer acceptance reference.
Unknown, expired, revoked, mismatched, self-supplied, or unverifiable keys are rejected.
Private keys, signing tokens, seeds, hidden data, and raw per-sequence outcomes are prohibited from this repository and from the public registry.

evidence_ledger.failure_semantics: Completed, failed, aborted, crashed, duplicate, or missing-output attempts are immutable ledger entries; none may be silently retried, replaced, or omitted.

attestation_and_signature.structural_validity_limit: A valid signature proves only that a registered key signed the bound bytes; it does not prove independence, hidden-data non-observation, scientific adequacy, gate passage, release, or recognition.

review_workflow: Independent reviewer accepts the frozen v4 specification, protocol digest, role identities, separation attestations, and registry custody before candidate freeze review.
Implementation owner submits a v4-bound freeze receipt and public-only candidate bundle; reviewer independently recomputes bindings and accepts or rejects it.

Independent evaluator performing the frozen-v4 hidden_dataset_provider duty records a pre-run hidden commitment outside the repository; reviewer verifies commitment completeness without disclosing hidden content.
Evaluator runs the frozen candidate and independently owned baselines and ablations in fresh network-disabled, read-only processes and finalizes every attempt in the append-only ledger.

Evaluator releases only permitted aggregate evidence and detached signature; reviewer verifies registries, attestation freshness, signature, ledger completeness, contamination controls, and claim boundary.
A separately authorized evaluation-gate review may assess admissibility. Neither preparation nor intake automatically passes G0, G1, another gate, a stage exit, release, or recognition.

repository_contract_tests: v4 specification and rejected v3 identifiers are bound correctly
candidate freeze receipt requires every digest and post-freeze invalidation
hidden custody and candidate inputs prohibit seed, labels, hidden examples, latent metadata, and per-sequence correctness
identity, registry, key, ledger, attestation, signature, and review requirements are complete and fail closed
all claim-boundary flags remain false and no runtime path is authorized
external_independent_tests: reviewer recomputes freeze and evidence digests from accepted artifacts
independent evaluator demonstrates the frozen-v4 hidden_dataset_provider duty, pre-run commitment, and split-isolation/search-space-floor evidence without disclosure
evaluator demonstrates fresh network-disabled process isolation, full-ledger finalization, and aggregate-only output
reviewer exercises unknown, revoked, expired, mismatched, self-signed, incomplete, repeated, and post-freeze evidence rejection
independent security and scientific review validate organizational separation, custody, reproducibility, contamination controls, baseline/ablation execution, and gate admissibility

external_blockers.cause: No accepted v4-bound public candidate, complete freeze receipt, and reviewer-verified reproducibility bundle exist.
external_blockers.owner: implementation owner with independent reviewer acceptance
external_blockers.required_evidence: Committed clean v4-bound candidate, public train/development artifact, complete receipt bindings, canonical digest recomputation record, and explicit hidden-data exclusion.
external_blockers.required_approval: Independent reviewer acceptance of the candidate freeze receipt.
external_blockers.impact: Hidden attachment and any independent scoring remain blocked.
external_blockers.unblocker: Produce a separately scoped public-only v4 candidate-freeze package and have the independent reviewer accept it.

external_blockers.cause: No externally attested independent evaluator (including frozen-v4 hidden_dataset_provider duty), reviewer, custody model, or accepted public-key and attestation registries are established.
external_blockers.required_evidence: Identity, organizational-separation, conflict, role, custody, registry-custodian, key-custody, and revocation attestations from outside the implementation trust domain.
external_blockers.required_approval: Independent-review authority approval of identities, separation, registry custody, and admissibility process.
external_blockers.impact: Repository-only work cannot establish evaluator independence or trusted signature verification.
external_blockers.unblocker: Appoint and externally attest a qualified independent evaluator performing the frozen-v4 provider duty, an independent reviewer, and registry custodian before hidden commitment.

external_blockers.cause: No hidden artifact, seed custody, pre-run commitment, independent run, or signed aggregate evidence exists.
external_blockers.owner: independent evaluator performing the frozen-v4 hidden-artifact-provider duty
external_blockers.required_evidence: Pre-run commitment, custody attestation, append-only ledger, aggregate baseline/ablation and confidence evidence, contamination and hard-failure reports, and detached signature verified against the accepted registry.
external_blockers.required_approval: Independent reviewer admissibility review and separately authorized evaluation-gate review.
external_blockers.impact: EVAL-01 is not performed; no gate, stage, release, or recognition result may be claimed.
external_blockers.unblocker: After B1 and B2, conduct the external independent evaluation under the accepted protocol and submit its aggregate evidence for independent review.
